source.name: UTC's public online timetable (utconline.uk.gov.in/timetable.aspx), built into GTFS by reclaim.city (utc_bus)
source.detail: Unofficial: UTC publishes no open GTFS. Termini are hand-placed bus stands; other stops are matched to OpenStreetMap places and GeoNames (else Nominatim) along OSRM's road between the termini, ordered and snapped on that road, and joined by OSRM. Daily calendar. Schedule only: UTC's Track My Bus needs a ticket PNR and a captcha, so there is no open live feed. Read Nov 2026.
